title: Maschke semisimplicity for a finite group algebra
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $G$ be a finite group, and assume $|G|\cdot1_k\ne0$. The group algebra $k[G]$, the $k$-vector space with basis $[g]$ and bilinear multiplication $[g][h]=[gh]$, is semisimple: its regular left module is a sum of simple left ideals, where simple [def-weil-pbc-simple-module] means nonzero with no nonzero proper submodule.
